```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(httr2)

options(HTTPUserAgent = "EDI_CodeGen")
```

## Authentication

PASTA now authenticates through the EDI Identity and Access Manager. Anonymous
requests return `403` because the `Public Access` profile has no read permission.
```{r}
#| label: auth
edi_token <- function(key = Sys.getenv("EDI_API_KEY")) {
  if (!nzchar(key)) {
    stop("EDI_API_KEY is not set. See the setup steps above.")
  }
  request("https://auth.edirepository.org/auth/v1/key") |>
    req_body_json(list(key = key)) |>
    req_perform() |>
    # The endpoint returns JSON but sends no Content-Type header.
    resp_body_json(check_type = FALSE) |>
    pluck("edi-token")
}
```

## Read the data
Downloaded once and cached locally, so a later PASTA outage doesn't break the render.

```{r}
#| label: read-data
infile1 <- "https://pasta.lternet.edu/package/data/eml/knb-lter-knz/42/25/3565885edc7640f2276174ca1f00240b"
cache_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")


if (!file.exists(cache_file)) {
  request(infile1) |>
    req_headers(Cookie = paste0("edi-token=", edi_token())) |>
    req_perform(path = cache_file)
}

burn_history <- read_csv(cache_file, na = c(" ", ".", "NA", "")) |>
  mutate(Date = as_date(Date, format = "%Y/%m/%d"))

glimpse(burn_history)
```

## Summaries

```{r}
#| label: summary
summary(burn_history)
```


## Watershed boundaries

```{r}
#| label: watershed-boundaries
konza_watersheds <- function(layer = "GIS030") {
  str_glue(
    "https://services3.arcgis.com/NLHBHJt7gvEcsduu/arcgis/rest/services/",
    "{layer}/FeatureServer/0/query",
    "?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=26914&f=geojson"
  ) |>
    st_read(quiet = TRUE)
}

knz_sheds <- konza_watersheds("GIS030")
knz_sheds |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(NAME, CODE, HECTARES) |>
  arrange(NAME)
```

### Join fire history to geometry

```{r}
#| label: join-spatial
burns_per_watershed <- burn_history |>
  count(Watershed, name = "n_burns")

knz_sheds_burns <- knz_sheds |>
  left_join(burns_per_watershed, by = join_by(NAME == Watershed))

# Watersheds in the fire record with no matching polygon in this era.
anti_join(
  burns_per_watershed,
  st_drop_geometry(knz_sheds),
  by = join_by(Watershed == NAME)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: map-burns
knz_sheds_burns |>
  mutate(
    NAME = na_if(trimws(NAME), "")
  ) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = n_burns), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf_text(
    aes(label = paste(NAME, " - ", CODE)),
    size = 3,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(
    fill = "Burns Recorded",
    title = "Konza Burns by Watershed"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```



```{r}
#| label: shane-creek-watershed

aims_sheds <- st_read(
  "/Users/connor/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/AIMS/GIS/Results/AIMS_GreatPlains.gpkg",
  layer = "Watersheds",
  quiet = TRUE
) |>
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(knz_sheds_burns)) |>
  filter(watershed %in% c("KNZ", "SHN"))
```


```{r}
knz_sheds_burns |>
  mutate(
    NAME = na_if(trimws(NAME), "")

  ) +

```
